_comment: Intake stub for the original Discrete 4 (USB PID 0xa270). This is NOT the Discrete 4 Synergy Core (0xa2be, discrete_4_sc.json) and nothing from that profile, Zen Go or Orion is assumed to apply. Every feature is disabled until this device's own captures confirm it. See docs/linux-parity-plan.md.

device.name: Antelope Discrete 4
device.notes: vid/pid/bcdDevice and product string "Discrete4" read from the attached unit's USB device descriptor (macOS IORegistry / system_profiler, 2026-11-16). Device class 0xEF/0x02/0x01 (interface association), bcdUSB 2.00, high speed, one configuration. Serial deliberately not recorded.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.status: disabled -- no command or state mapping captured on this device

usb_interfaces.notes: Interface classes from the device's own descriptors. Endpoint addresses, packet sizes, alternate settings and UAC2 channel clusters were NOT readable on macOS without vendor tooling; take them from `lsusb -v -d 23e5:a270` on Linux before relying on any of them.

transport.notes: Interface 3 is a HID interface with two endpoints (observed). Report size, report IDs and endpoint addresses are unknown: run tools/hid_probe.py on Linux first. The vendor manager-server log names in-band requests with magic 0x74 and responses 0x75 for this unit, which matches the family readback shape in PROTOCOL.md §4a, but that is a hint, not a capture.
transport.evidence: owner's unit, macOS ioreg, 2026-11-16; vendor manager-server runtime log (names only)

command.notes: No outbound command captured. Do not assume any sibling's 0x70 / opcode / param-id layout.

state_report.notes: Whether this device streams a passive state report, and with which magic, is unknown.

intake_hints.notes: Readback requests the vendor panel issued on connect, as printed (names + category/index) in the vendor's own runtime logs on the owner's Mac, 2026-11-13..16. They are hints for planning captures ONLY. They are not device-derived category_counts and must not be used as query bounds (PROTOCOL.md §4a hazard). Confirm each with a usbmon capture of the vendor connect walk before adding frame.readback.
intake_hints.audio_streaming_hint: The macOS vendor driver exposed 16 in / 16 out, 24-bit, 32k-192k. Check the device's own UAC2 descriptors and snd-usb-audio behaviour on Linux; do not copy these numbers into a profile without that.

channels.notes: Preamp count not yet established from this device's reports.

open_questions: HID report descriptor, report size, report-ID framing on hidraw, endpoint addresses.
Does the device stream a passive state report? Which magic? Which magic carries meters?

Confirmed outer bounds for every readback category in intake_hints.connect_walk.
